text.p: These are the highlights of stories in the Skopje press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Macedonia begins 10 days of celebrating the Ilinden national holiday. President Kiro Gligorov expected to address the nation on August 2.

- Macedonian and Yugoslav diplomatic expert teams ended the sixth in a series of talks on border delineation in Skopje on Thursday. It was agreed that additional work needs to be done ahead of the next round.
- Fake bomb alarm interrupts Ilindenski denovi festival in Bitola.
- High banking interest rates direct funds into banks rather than security trading.

- Two Albanian citizens were killed and another wounded in an incident on the Macedonian-Albanian border on Thursday. Sources in Struga say many Albanians enter Macedonia illegally in a bid to sell firearms.

- Ethnic Albanian DPA political party advises against displaying Albanian flag on public buildings during Ilinden holiday. The party says this would be cynical after the ethnic bloodshed which took place in Gostivar on June 9. -- Mircela Casule, Skopje newsroom +389 91 201196
